stories.headline: SoftBank to Build 10GW AI Datacenter on Former US Nuclear Weapons Site in Ohio

key_facts.fact: SoftBank's SB Energy is redeveloping Department of Energy land at the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant in Piketon, Ohio for a massive AI datacenter campus called 'PORTS Technology Campus'
key_facts.excerpt: Softbank's SB Energy is redeveloping Department of Energy (DoE) land in Ohio for a massive datacenter campus, adding extra generation facilities and power infrastructure alongside it.

key_facts.fact: The project includes a 10GW server farm, 10GW of new power generation capacity (minimum 9.2GW gas-fired), and a $4.2 billion grid upgrade across Southern Ohio by American Electric Power
key_facts.excerpt: 10GW server farm, 10GW of new generation, and $4.2bn grid upgrade. And someone else is paying for the uranium cleanup

key_facts.fact: Consortium includes Hitachi, Mitsubishi Electric, Toshiba, TDK, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking, Bechtel, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan
key_facts.excerpt: SB Energy commits to funding accelerated cleanup of uranium contamination at the site

key_facts.fact: Power expected to reach the site by 2029; SB Energy commits to funding accelerated cleanup of uranium contamination
key_facts.excerpt: Power expected to reach site by 2029

key_facts.fact: Energy Secretary Chris Wright stated the investment 'supports the AI boom and cutting-edge technologies while strengthening our energy system and helping keep costs down for the American people'
key_facts.excerpt: By bringing new power online and upgrading our existing infrastructure, this investment supports the AI boom and cutting-edge technologies while strengthening our energy system and helping keep costs down for the American people.

sources.title: SoftBank to build massive AI datacenter on former US nuclear weapons site

stories.headline: Nvidia and Emerald AI Unveil Flexible AI Data Centers with Six Major Utilities, Claiming 100GW Potential

key_facts.fact: Nvidia and grid software company Emerald AI announced a coalition with six major energy companies — AES, Constellation, Invenergy, NextEra Energy, Nscale Energy & Power, and Vistra — to build AI data centers that dynamically respond to grid conditions
key_facts.excerpt: The coalition states they can 'unlock up to 100 gigawatts of additional power capacity' by constructing AI data centers that dynamically respond to grid conditions.

key_facts.fact: The system pairs Nvidia's DSX Flex software (allowing data centers to draw on co-located generation and battery storage before full grid connection) with Emerald AI's Conductor platform (coordinating electricity usage alongside onsite generators and batteries)
key_facts.excerpt: DSX Flex (Nvidia software): Allows data centers to draw on co-located generation and battery storage before full grid connection, potentially accelerating facility deployment

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang described the effort as 'Energy, compute, networking and cooling as one architecture'; Emerald AI CEO Varun Sivaram said 'AI factories are too valuable to be treated as either passive loads or permanent islands'
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang, Nvidia founder and CEO, described the effort as a fundamental shift: 'Energy, compute, networking and cooling as one architecture.'

key_facts.fact: Early demonstrations completed across five commercial data centers; commercial deployment targeted for later in 2026 at Nvidia AI Factory Research Center in Virginia
key_facts.excerpt: Early demonstrations: Completed across five commercial data centers. Commercial deployment target: Later in 2026 at Nvidia AI Factory Research Center in Virginia

sources.title: Nvidia and Energy Partners Unveil Flexible AI Data Centres to Ease Grid Pressure

stories.headline: Google Warns US Power Grid Can't Keep Up with AI Data Center Demand at CERAWeek

key_facts.fact: Alphabet/Google President Ruth Porat stated 'We are concerned that we are not full throttle on energy' at CERAWeek in Houston on March 23, flagging power as an obstacle on par with semiconductors for AI
key_facts.excerpt: Google sounded the alarm Monday over what it sees as lagging U.S. electricity development, flagging power as an obstacle on par with semiconductors for the next generation of AI data centers. 'We are concerned that we are not full throttle on energy,' said Alphabet and Google President Ruth Porat, speaking at CERAWeek in Houston.

key_facts.fact: US electricity demand rose 1.7% annually since 2020 after a decade of flat usage; projected to increase 1.9% in 2026 and 2.5% in 2027, with data centers expected to reach 9% of US demand by 2030 (up from 4% in 2025)
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. electricity demand rose 1.7% annually since 2020 (after a decade of flat usage). Projected 2026 increase: 1.9%. Projected 2027 increase: 2.5%. Data centers expected to reach 9% of U.S. electricity demand by 2030 (up from 4% in 2025)

key_facts.fact: Google has made available up to 1 gigawatt of demand-response capacity, equivalent to powering approximately 750,000 homes
key_facts.excerpt: Made available up to 1 gigawatt of demand-response capacity (equivalent to powering ~750,000 homes)

key_facts.fact: Energy stocks surged on the day: Constellation Energy +$7.68, Vistra Energy +$5.73, Talen Energy +$13.09
key_facts.excerpt: Constellation Energy: +$7.68. Vistra Energy: +$5.73. Talen Energy: +$13.09

sources.title: AI Data Center Power Crisis Deepens After Google Warns U.S. Grid Can't Keep Up

stories.headline: TSMC's 2nm Capacity Crunch May Force Nvidia to Redesign Next-Gen Feynman AI Chip Platform

key_facts.fact: TSMC is completely booked on its advanced 2nm production capacity through at least 2028, with explosive demand for AI and HPC straining cutting-edge nodes including the A16 variant with backside power delivery
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM), aka TSMC, is overbooked on its advanced 2-nanometer (nm) production capacity. Explosive demand for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) has strained these cutting-edge nodes.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia may be forced to redesign its next-generation Feynman AI chip platform, the successor to Vera Rubin architectures unveiled at GTC 2026, due to limited TSMC manufacturing capacity
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia (NVDA, Financials) may be forced to redesign its next-generation Feynman AI chip platform due to limited manufacturing capacity at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, according to a media report.

key_facts.fact: Big AI companies like Nvidia and Meta are fighting for access to the same cutting-edge production lines, making AI chip supply tighter across the board; even TSMC's Arizona facility (not fully operational until 2030) is already fully reserved
key_facts.excerpt: There is a lot of demand for sophisticated 2-nanometer circuits, and TSMC (TSM) is said to be completely booked until at least 2028. Big AI companies like Nvidia and Meta are fighting for access to the same cutting-edge production lines.

key_facts.fact: TSMC's A16 variant offers 8-10% speed gains over prior nodes through backside power delivery technology
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker... facing unprecedented strain on its 2nm manufacturing nodes, including the advanced A16 variant, with backside power delivery for 8-10% speed gains over prior nodes.

sources.title: TSMC's 2nm Capacity Crunch Forces Nvidia to Rethink Feynman AI Platform
Nvidia May Redesign Feynman Chip on TSMC Limits
NVIDIA's Feynman AI Chip May Face Redesign Amid TSMC Capacity Crunch

stories.headline: US Army Receives First Autonomous-Ready Black Hawk Helicopter, the H-60Mx

key_facts.fact: The US Army officially received its first H-60Mx Black Hawk helicopter on March 23, 2026 — a modified Black Hawk capable of flying with or without a pilot
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Army officially received its first H-60Mx Black Hawk helicopter on Friday, March 23, 2026

key_facts.fact: Uses Sikorsky's MATRIX autonomy software suite, derived from DARPA's decade-long Aircrew Labor In-Cockpit Automation System (ALIAS) program
key_facts.excerpt: Uses Sikorsky's MATRIX autonomy software suite. Derived from DARPA's Aircrew Labor In-Cockpit Automation System (ALIAS) program

key_facts.fact: The Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) will conduct rigorous testing to validate seamless transitions between manned, optionally piloted, and fully autonomous modes
key_facts.excerpt: The Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) will conduct rigorous testing in the coming months, aiming for the aircraft to 'seamlessly transition between manned, optionally piloted and fully autonomous modes.'

key_facts.fact: The H-60Mx serves as the primary testbed for the Strategic Autonomy Flight Enabler (SAFE) program, which seeks to develop a universal autonomy kit deployable across the entire Black Hawk fleet
key_facts.excerpt: The H-60Mx serves as the primary testbed for the Strategic Autonomy Flight Enabler (SAFE) program, which seeks to develop a universal autonomy kit deployable across the entire Black Hawk fleet.

key_facts.fact: Sikorsky's Rich Benton noted: 'This capability will enhance mission effectiveness and survivability for warfighters today and lay the groundwork for tomorrow's networked systems'
key_facts.excerpt: Sikorsky's Rich Benton noted: 'This capability will enhance mission effectiveness and survivability for warfighters today and lay the groundwork for tomorrow's networked systems.'

sources.title: Army Receives First Autonomous-Ready Optionally Piloted Black Hawk

stories.headline: US Army Places $52M+ Order for 2,500 Skydio X10D Drones, Largest Single-Vendor Tactical sUAS Order in Army History

key_facts.fact: The US Army ordered over 2,500 Skydio X10D drones for $52+ million — the largest small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS) procurement from a single manufacturer in Army history
key_facts.excerpt: Skydio, the largest U.S. drone manufacturer and world leader in flying robots, announced yesterday a $52+ million order for over 2,500 X10D drones from the U.S. Army. The order is the largest small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS) procurement from a single manufacturer in the Army's history.

key_facts.fact: The order moved from bid to award in less than 72 hours, reflecting urgency in military drone procurement
key_facts.excerpt: moved from bid to award in less than 72 hours

key_facts.fact: Skydio described itself as 'the largest U.S. drone manufacturer and world leader in flying robots'; the order reflects 'the decisive role small autonomous systems now play in modern conflict'
key_facts.excerpt: This order reflects the decisive role small autonomous systems now play in modern conflict

sources.title: U.S. Army Places $52+ Million Order for Skydio X10D, the Largest Single-Vendor Tactical sUAS Order in Army History

stories.headline: GM Begins Supervised Autonomous Testing on Public Roads in California and Michigan

key_facts.fact: GM announced it will start supervised public-road testing of autonomous driving technology on limited-access highways across California and Michigan, with the goal of reaching 200 vehicles this year
key_facts.excerpt: The automaker plans to start supervised public-road testing on limited access highways across California and Michigan, with the goal of reaching 200 vehicles this year.

key_facts.fact: Each vehicle will operate with a trained test driver at the wheel capable of taking manual control at any time, marking a transition from manual data collection to active automated technology testing
key_facts.excerpt: Each vehicle will operate with a trained test driver at the wheel who is capable of taking manual control at any time. This marks a significant transition from manual data collection to active automated technology testing on public roads.

key_facts.fact: GM has said it will launch its first hands-free, eyes-off Level 3 driving feature in the Cadillac Escalade IQ in 2028
key_facts.excerpt: GM has said it will launch its first hands-free, eyes-off Level 3 driving feature in the Cadillac Escalade IQ in 2028.

stories.headline: Enigma Aerospace Emerges from Stealth with Autonomous Cargo Drone for Contested Military Logistics

key_facts.fact: Enigma Aerospace, a defense technology company based in Burlington, Massachusetts, emerged from stealth with $7M in aggregate venture and Department of War funding from investors including Cybernetix Ventures, Valia Ventures, and the U.S. Air Force
key_facts.excerpt: Enigma Aerospace, a defense technology company building autonomous logistics systems for contested environments, today announced its emergence from stealth. The company, which previously secured $7M in aggregate venture and Department of War funding.

key_facts.fact: The Phoenix aircraft is an autonomous, ultra long-range cargo drone with up to 1,000 lb payload capacity, exceeding 2,000 nautical miles range, capable of precision airdrop or short takeoff/landing in GPS-denied environments
key_facts.excerpt: Company introduces Phoenix™ aircraft and Strata™ software to enable long-range, runway-independent, autonomous resupply anywhere on Earth

key_facts.fact: CEO Reese Mozer's core thesis: 'Logistics — not firepower — is the limiting factor in modern warfare'; the company targets deployment by 2027
key_facts.excerpt: Logistics—not firepower—is the limiting factor in modern warfare

key_facts.fact: Team includes veterans from American Robotics, Ondas, Carnegie Mellon, Stanford, and the U.S. Air Force; advisors include Gen. (ret) Mike Minihan (USAF Air Mobility Command) and Gen. (fmr) Charles Hamilton (USA Army Materiel Command)
key_facts.excerpt: Veterans from American Robotics, Ondas, Carnegie Mellon, Stanford, U.S. Air Force

stories.headline: Netherlands Becomes First NATO Nation to Embed Drone and Counter-Drone Units in Every Army Combat Formation

key_facts.fact: The Netherlands will begin recruiting 1,000-1,200 military personnel starting in April to staff newly created drone and counter-drone units embedded across every combat formation in the Royal Netherlands Army
key_facts.excerpt: Starting in April, the Netherlands will begin recruiting between 1,000 and 1,200 military personnel to staff newly created drone and counter-drone units that will be embedded across every combat formation in the Royal Netherlands Army.

key_facts.fact: Commander of the Armed Forces General Onno Eichelsheim announced the initiative on Dutch TV program WNL Op Zondag, stating 'It is a different interaction. We must continuously modernize and adapt systems'
key_facts.excerpt: Commandant der Strijdkrachten (Commander of the Armed Forces) General Onno Eichelsheim made the announcement on the Dutch television program WNL Op Zondag... 'It is a different interaction. We must continuously modernize and adapt systems.'

key_facts.fact: This is a structural overhaul — not a pilot program or task force — making the Dutch army the most drone-integrated ground force in NATO, with no other ally having gone this far or this fast
key_facts.excerpt: The Dutch army is about to become the most drone-integrated ground force in NATO... not as a centralized capability, but as organic parts of each fighting unit. According to the country's top military commander, no other NATO ally has gone this far, this fast.

sources.title: Netherlands Becomes First NATO Nation To Embed Drone And Counter-Drone Units In Every Army Combat Formation — And Is Hiring 1,200 People To Do It
